program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((comps (sort (objects g 0)
                      (lambda (a b)
                        (if (= (obj-color a) (obj-color b))
                            (< (obj-size a) (obj-size b))
                            (< (obj-color a) (obj-color b))))))
         (n (length comps)))
    (grid-from-fn n n
      (lambda (r c)
        (let ((a (nth comps r)) (b (nth comps c)))
          (cond [(= r c) 0]
                [(> (obj-size a) (obj-size b)) (obj-color a)]
                [(> (obj-size b) (obj-size a)) (obj-color b)]
                [else 0]))))))
